purpose: Authorize one exact-local-official-USDA Writer runtime control that finally tests the pinned headless Replicator path without the v1 remote-asset dependency.

approval.scope: One official four-cube control world, one exact content-frozen official Example_Rotary USDA, one fixed pose and at most 300 render frames in the pinned network-disabled Isaac Sim 6.0.1 image. Record creation/attach/frame/Writer/GMO health only. No point sample, Cano, custom project sensor, formal data, label, training, model, topology, M-TARE change, fallback or retry.
approval.confirmation_reference: User message after the current purpose and exact v2 scope were explained: 继续吧

source.license_or_allowed_use: The exact NVIDIA Isaac 6.0 diagnostic asset and Apache-2.0 example are used locally only to diagnose the pinned runtime. The asset is not redistributed, treated as project training data or substituted for the project sensor.

sampling.selection_rule: Load the exact hash-frozen self-contained official USDA locally, place it at [0,0,1] in the official four-cube layout, attach one GMO renderProduct Writer, update exactly 300 frames and retain no point samples.
sampling.sensor_contract: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 Lidar.create(usd_path=...) with the 15,137-byte Example_Rotary USDA sha256 0812faf5...56c8c6, BASIC auxiliary output, one LidarSensor and one registered GenericModelOutput Writer; network disabled.
sampling.label_contract: No semantic, structural or topology labels are produced. Successful sensor creation, Writer attach, updated frames, callback count, valid GMO headers, positive elements and complete scans are diagnostic metrics only.

evidence.machine_metrics: Preserve asset/tool/reference/image hashes, exact command, raw log, local control stage, creation/attach/frame/callback/payload/GMO/return/complete-scan metrics, drain-timeout flag, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and evidence manifest.
evidence.complete_visual_review: No visualization is produced because this control tests runtime plumbing rather than point-cloud quality. The full generated USD stage and complete machine metrics are retained for audit.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop after the single run on hash, creation, attach, callback, GMO, positive-return, evidence, drain or timeout failure. Do not change the asset, image, host, scene, Writer method, use another sensor, enable network, retry, restore Cano or save samples.

estimated_cost.compute: One short headless RTX GPU process in the pinned network-disabled Isaac Sim 6.0.1 image; no dependency installation, point sample or visualization.
